scheduleTabs.loopDescription:
Goal Loop is designed for long-running work. Give AI a goal, and it can work continuously for up to dozens of hours, organizing context along the way until the goal is fully reached.

After turning on Goal Loop, write what you want to accomplish in the input box and send it to begin. During the process, you can add information or adjust direction at any time, and AI will carry it into the next steps.

trigger.alwaysDescription: Wake the AI when the time schedule fires, preserving normal Task behavior.
trigger.commandDescription: Run a local command first; wake the AI only when it returns activate.
